name: West Virginia
description: Follow West Virginia, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: A look at 'Operation Country Roads,' West Virginia's ICE operation
changes.summary: Earlier this year ICE arrested 600 immigrants over a two week period. Most migrants had no criminal records and, since then, West Virginia has decided to not hold ICE detainees in their jails. A look at West Virginia post Operation Country Roads.

changes.title: C.D.C. Expands Cyclospora Outbreak Linked to Iceberg Lettuce to Nine States
changes.summary: Illinois, Kansas, Oklahoma and Pennsylvania now join Michigan, Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and West Virginia in cyclospora outbreak linked to iceberg lettuce.

changes.title: 2 dead after flash floods inundate West Virginia; National Guard deployed
changes.summary: Torrential rains in West Virginia have caused flash flooding that inundated homes and businesses this week.

changes.title: West Virginia paid digital nomads to move there during COVID. Many are staying
changes.summary: Ascend West Virginia is one of dozens of relocation initiatives across the country offering cash and other incentives to move to states needing an economic boost. Here's how they're working out. (Image credit: Chris Jackson for NPR).

changes.title: Deadly flooding in the East
changes.summary: At least two people have lost their lives after widespread flooding in West Virginia. We're also tracking Tropical Storm Bertha as it hits Texas. NBC News’ Priscilla Thompson is in the storm zone.
